_doc: ASHRAE 140 Case 950 annual cooling reference for the surrogate-layer MAE gate (issue #3584). The surrogate's annual cooling kWh (solved by `SurrogateThermalModel::solve_timesteps`) is compared against the EnergyPlus published midpoint. The deviation is reported as a percentage of the band midpoint. The STRICT gate fires when an ONNX model is loaded and the deviation exceeds the 5% tolerance; the FALLBACK gate (no model loaded) reports the deviation informatively and exits 0 unless the deviation regresses beyond the recorded baseline beyond regression_tolerance_kwh. Update the `current_measured_kwh` / `current_gap_pct_of_mid` fields in the same PR that improves the engine (per RULES.md / AGENTS.md: never raise the baseline to hide a regression).
_source: Extracted from tests/reference_data/zone_balance/case_950_energy_reference.csv (ASHRAE 140-2023 Annex B8 inter-program envelope, validated across BEM programs incl. EnergyPlus; high-mass with heating disabled + night ventilation 18:00-07:00). Hourly EnergyPlus output: tests/reference_data/zone_balance/case_950_energy_hourly.csv. Same authoritative source as the strict ±15% annual-energy gate (issue #1333) and the surrogate drift-gate held-out validation dataset (issue #1784).
description: High-mass (200mm concrete) 6m x 8m x 2.7m with heating disabled and night ventilation fan (18:00-07:00); south-facing 12 m² window, USA_CO_Golden-NREL.724666_TMY3.epw
_tolerance_pct_doc: Strict ±5% gate vs. the EnergyPlus midpoint (Issue #2924 acceptance extended to all surrogate-routed cases per Issue #3584). When the ONNX model is loaded the gate fails on any deviation > 5% of |midpoint|. In fallback mode this becomes a regression ceiling instead (regression_tolerance_kwh below).
_regression_tolerance_kwh_doc: Fallback-mode regression ceiling. Smaller than the 250 kWh ceiling used for the larger-load Cases 600/800/900/810/920/960/970 because Case 950's absolute cooling load is small (0.655 MWh midpoint) — a 250 kWh regression ceiling is half the band on this case. Tightened to 100 kWh to keep the proportional regression guard meaningful.
_current_measured_kwh_doc: Most recent measured surrogate value when the surrogate is in fallback mode (no trained ONNX model shipped). The surrogate's synthetic weather cycle (0–20 °C, see SurrogateThermalLoadAdapter::solve_timesteps in src/sim/thermal_model.rs) cannot reproduce the EnergyPlus outdoor temperature range that drives the published Case 950 cooling demand, so the measured kWh is 0 in the default build. The strict-ORT gate target is energyplus_reference_kwh × (1 ± tolerance_pct/100).
_status_doc: Per AGENTS.md / RULES.md: this records the KNOWN gap from the EnergyPlus reference; it must never be loosened to hide a regression. Only lower the gap when the engine genuinely improves and commit the engine fix + baseline update together.
